column1: // Builtin sound lexicon: interjections, moans, laughs, sound effects and
// mimetics, in the plain dictionary format (JP, KR, POS intj, ono, lead or open).
// A key matches in hiragana and katakana alike, with elongation (はぁぁ,
// あーーん, きゃああっ). intj rows stand alone; ono rows may take grammar
// after them (する, の, に) and drop a following と; lead rows are
// interjections only at the start of an utterance and before a pause
// (おい、 ちょっと…, but not ちょっと高い); open rows are lead rows that need no pause
きーんこーんかーんこーん
